evals.prompt: I have review comments on this MR: https://gitlab.com/campingcarpark/si-main/octopus/-/merge_requests/12659. Can you fetch the unresolved discussions, tell me which ones can be auto-fixed, and apply the safe fixes? Commit locally but do not push.
evals.expected_output: Fetches discussions from MR 12659, applies the yield suggestion (comment 3), attempts to interpret comment 1 about kernel injection, skips comment 2 (infrastructure question), commits locally with a descriptive message.
expectations: Uses glab api to fetch discussions for the correct project and MR IID
Identifies the suggestion block in comment 3 and applies it
Classifies comment 2 as 'needs human' because it is a question
Creates a local git commit without pushing
Produces a summary report listing applied vs skipped comments

evals.prompt: Fix the review feedback on MR !12659 of the octopus project.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the project from git remote origin, fetches discussions for MR 12659, applies auto-fixable suggestions, produces a report.
expectations: Resolves project path from git remote or uses the explicit IID
Applies at least one suggestion block automatically
Does not resolve discussions on GitLab

evals.prompt: I'm on a branch with an open MR and there are code review comments I need to address. Can you help me fix them automatically?
evals.expected_output: Detects current branch, finds the open MR for that branch using glab mr list, fetches discussions, applies safe fixes, commits locally.
expectations: Detects current branch with git branch --show-current
Queries glab mr list with --source-branch to find the MR
Handles the case where zero or multiple MRs exist gracefully
